hypotheses.reasoning: notif-db ran out of disk space at 22:29:51 (InnoDB 'No space left on device' on notifications.ibd). Because of that, notification-svc inserts fail with error 1114 'table is full'/ER_RECORD_FILE_FULL, and api-gateway returns 500 on POST /v1/notify. Reads keep working because only writes need disk space. The errors in flag-sync and billing-reconciler have nothing to do with the notify path.

verdict.recommendedAction: Free up or expand disk space on the notif-db volume right away (purge old notifications or binlogs, or grow the volume), then confirm inserts succeed. Add disk-usage alerts and a retention policy.
